about: Ask ICP a question about a service, a transaction or a general matter.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Submit an inquiry to ICP. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Supporting papers where relevant; no fixed list
